description: Makes every item's draft content its published content - what a QuestionBank block of a live Riddle actually draws at view time - so the change reaches participants immediately: every Riddle using the bank is republished and re-draws its questions, even when nothing changed. The previously published content of each item is overwritten, and a pending item delete (question_bank_item_delete on a published item) is purged for good at this point. A bank with unpublished changes still works in a block, it just draws its last published state; question_bank_discard_changes is the opposite step. Read question_bank_get_items with and without published: true first when unsure what will change. Rejected for a public template id. Needs full access: riddle://reference/concepts/access.

questionBankId.description: The ID of the question bank to publish.

name: question_bank_publish
